newsitem.title: USA: Grill Concepts blames drop on brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Grill Concepts blames drop on brokerage.

text.p: Grill Concepts Inc said on Wednesday that the unusual drop in its stock price may stem from investor reaction to the National Association of Security Dealers's closure of a Florida-based brokerage firm, Joseph Roberts & Co., one of the company's market makers.
In a statement, the company said the closure related to Joseph Roberts & Co's involvement in a matter entirely unrelated to Grill Concepts or any aspect of its business.

President and Chief Executive Officer Robert Spivak said the company is well positioned to continue its expansion plans, with the recent opening of its Daily Grill in Irvine, California, where the company is registering higher than projected sales. In addition, Grill Concepts is on schedule to open a Daily Grill in the Tom Bradley International Terminal at Los Angeles International Airport in December and construction has begun on a third Daily Grill in Washington D.C., which is slated to open early next year.
